mainTopic: Whether a woman whose baby died within thirty days must perform חליצה, and the limits of רבי יהודה's view that an אנדרוגינוס is male
overview: This amud begins by finishing a dispute about what רבא ruled. The case is a woman whose husband died leaving only a baby, and the baby died within thirty days, so it may have been a נפל. That means she might still be bound to her husband's brother for יבום, and in the meantime she married someone else. רבינא reports that רבא ruled that a ישראל's wife does חליצה but a כהן's wife does not, since a חלוצה is forbidden to a כהן. רב שרביא reports that רבא said both must do חליצה. רבינא answers that רבא said that at night but retracted in the morning, and רב שרביא replies with a sarcastic rebuke. The גמרא then returns to the משנה, where רבי יהודה permits a ברית מילה on שבת for an אנדרוגינוס. רב חסדא limits this: רבי יהודה does not treat an אנדרוגינוס as male in every area, since he is excluded from ערכין. A ברייתא proves that exclusion. The verses 'הזכר' and 'ואם נקבה היא' cover only a definite male and a definite female, so a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס get no valuation at all.

steps.title: רבא's ruling as reported by רבינא: an ישראל's wife does חליצה, a כהן's wife does not
steps.stepSummary: רבא's ruling, in רבינא's version, splits the case by who the new husband is.
steps.simpleTranslation: If she is married to an ordinary ישראל, she does חליצה. If she is married to a כהן, she does not do חליצה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is completing רבינא's report of רבא's ruling about the woman whose baby died within thirty days. The ruling depends on whether her new husband is an ישראל or a כהן.
steps.deeperAnalysis: An ישראל may marry a חלוצה, so doing חליצה costs her nothing and removes the doubt about יבום. A כהן may not marry a חלוצה, so חליצה would forbid her to her husband. In that case we rely on the opinion that the baby counted as alive, which means she never needed יבום at all.

keyTerms.meaning: She performs חליצה, the ceremony that releases a widow from יבום
The wife of an ordinary (non-כהן) Jew
The wife of a כהן, who is forbidden to marry a חלוצה

steps.confusionAlert: She is not exempt because the case is easier for a כהן's wife. She is exempt because doing חליצה would cause a new problem: she would become forbidden to her husband. Because of that cost, רבא (in רבינא's version) is willing to rely on the lenient opinion after the fact.

phrases.english: If she is the wife of an Israelite — she performs chalitza.
phrases.notes: חליצה removes the doubt and does not forbid her to a ישראל husband.

phrases.aramaic: אִם אֵשֶׁת כֹּהֵן הִיא — אֵינָהּ חוֹלֶצֶת.
phrases.english: If she is the wife of a kohen — she does not perform chalitza.
phrases.notes: חליצה would make her a חלוצה, who is forbidden to a כהן.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues רבינא's statement in רבא's name earlier.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: An ישראל's wife does חליצה; a כהן's wife does not, so that she is not forbidden to her husband.

steps.title: רב שרביא's version: both women must do חליצה
steps.stepSummary: רב שרביא reports a different, stricter ruling in רבא's name.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב שרביא said in רבא's name: both this woman and that woman perform חליצה.
steps.whatsHappening: A second student reports a different version of what רבא said. In this version, even the כהן's wife must do חליצה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In this version, the doubt about יבום is treated as too serious to ignore. Whether her husband is a כהן makes no difference, even though חליצה will forbid her to him.

keyTerms.meaning: In the name of
Both this one and that one

phrases.english: And Rav Sherevya said in the name of Rava:
Both this one and that one — perform chalitza.
phrases.notes: This covers both the ישראל's wife and the כהן's wife.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: A competing report of the same teacher's ruling.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Both the ישראל's wife and the כהן's wife must do חליצה.

steps.title: רבינא says רבא retracted that ruling
steps.stepSummary: רבינא explains that רב שרביא's version was רבא's earlier view, which he later withdrew.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבינא said to רב שרביא: In the evening רבא said it that way, but in the morning he retracted.
steps.whatsHappening: רבינא pushes back on רב שרביא's report. He agrees that רבא did say it, but only before he changed his mind.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Both reports are accurate quotes, but from different times. רבינא claims his version, the lenient one for a כהן's wife, is רבא's final position. This turns the dispute from 'who heard correctly' into 'which statement is the latest'.

keyTerms.meaning: In the evening
In the morning
He retracted; he went back on his statement

phrases.english: Ravina said to Rav Sherevya:
In the evening Rava said so,
in the morning he retracted it.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects step 2 as רבא's outdated position.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Rejects רב שרביא's version as רבא's final ruling, without denying that רבא once said it.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: The report reflects a statement that רבא later retracted.

steps.title: רב שרביא's sarcastic rebuke
steps.stepSummary: רב שרביא refuses to accept the lenient ruling and mocks it.
steps.simpleTranslation: He said to him: You permitted her without חליצה? May it be God's will that you also permit חלב (forbidden fat)!
steps.whatsHappening: רב שרביא answers רבינא with a sharp, sarcastic remark. He is not convinced.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In his eyes, letting a woman who may still be bound to יבום stay married without חליצה ignores רבן שמעון בן גמליאל's ruling that a baby who dies within thirty days may have been a נפל. He sarcastically says that someone this lenient might as well permit חלב. The point is that the leniency goes against an accepted rule.

keyTerms.meaning: You (plural) permitted her
May it be the (Divine) will
חלב, forbidden fat

steps.confusionAlert: He is not seriously wishing for anyone to permit חלב. This is sarcasm, meant to show how wrong he thinks the leniency is.

phrases.english: He said to him: Did you permit her?
phrases.notes: רב שרביא is speaking to רבינא.

phrases.english: May it be the will that you permit forbidden fat.
phrases.notes: Sarcasm: if you go against רשב״ג here, you may as well permit חלב.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Responds to רבינא's claim of retraction by attacking the lenient ruling itself.
steps.kashyaTarget: The ruling that a כהן's wife need not do חליצה.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Leaving her without חליצה ignores the real possibility, according to רבן שמעון בן גמליאל, that the baby was a נפל and she is still bound to יבום.

steps.title: רב חסדא limits רבי יהודה's view of the אנדרוגינוס
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא returns to the משנה. רבי יהודה treats an אנדרוגינוס as male for מילה, but not for everything.
steps.simpleTranslation: The משנה said: רבי יהודה permits, etc. רב שיזבי said in the name of רב חסדא: רבי יהודה did not say that an אנדרוגינוס is male for all matters.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא goes back to the משנה, where רבי יהודה allows a ברית מילה on שבת for an אנדרוגינוס. רב חסדא explains that this does not make an אנדרוגינוס male in every area of halacha.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי יהודה's ruling is limited to מילה, which overrides שבת for this baby. רב חסדא warns against stretching it into a general rule that an אנדרוגינוס is a full male everywhere.

keyTerms.meaning: Etc.; it marks a quote from the משנה
A person with both male and female features
Not for all matters
Permits

phrases.english: Rabbi Yehuda permits, etc.
phrases.notes: A quote from the משנה: he permits a ברית מילה for an אנדרוגינוס on שבת.

phrases.aramaic: אָמַר רַב שֵׁיזְבִי אָמַר רַב חִסְדָּא:
phrases.english: Rav Sheizvi said that Rav Chisda said:
Not with regard to all matters did Rabbi Yehuda say
that an androgynos is a male,

steps.relationToPreviousStep: A new topic: back to the משנה's statement about the אנדרוגינוס.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: רבי יהודה treats an אנדרוגינוס as male for מילה, not for all areas of halacha.

steps.title: Proof from valuation vows
steps.stepSummary: If an אנדרוגינוס were fully male, he would be included in ערכין, but he is not.
steps.simpleTranslation: For if you say so, then he should also be valuated with the valuation vows!
steps.whatsHappening: רב חסדא proves his limit. If an אנדרוגינוס were a full male, he would be included in the laws of ערכין, and he is not.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The Torah sets fixed ערכין amounts for a male and for a female. The משנה in ערכין excludes an אנדרוגינוס from these laws. So he cannot be a complete male, and רבי יהודה's ruling must be limited to מילה.

keyTerms.meaning: Valuation vows: pledging a person's fixed Torah 'value' to the בית המקדש
He would be valuated
For if you say so

steps.whatToRemember: רבי יהודה calls an אנדרוגינוס male only for מילה. The proof is that he is excluded from ערכין, which a true male would not be.
steps.whyThisMatters: It shows that a person's status as male can apply in one area of halacha (מילה) without making that person a full male in other areas.

phrases.english: for if you say so,
then with regard to valuations, he should be valuated!
phrases.notes: But the משנה in ערכין excludes an אנדרוגינוס, so he is not fully male.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Supports רב חסדא's limitation in step 5.
steps.raayaObject: That רבי יהודה does not treat an אנדרוגינוס as male in all respects.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The law that an אנדרוגינוס is excluded from ערכין.

steps.title: What is the source that he is not valuated?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks for the source of the claim that an אנדרוגינוס is not included in ערכין.
steps.simpleTranslation: And how do we know that he is not given a valuation?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא used the ערכין rule as proof in Step 6, so now it asks where that rule comes from. This question sets up the ברייתא that follows.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The proof in Step 6 only works if it is really true that an אנדרוגינוס has no ערכין valuation. So the גמרא checks this point and asks for a source text.

keyTerms.meaning: And from where do we know? (asking for a source)
Is valuated (given a fixed ערכין amount)
Pledging a person's fixed Torah value to the בית המקדש

phrases.english: And from where do we know that he is not valuated?
phrases.notes: Refers back to the אנדרוגינוס in Step 6.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Asks for the source of the premise used as proof in Step 6.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The Torah source showing that an אנדרוגינוס is excluded from ערכין.

steps.title: The verse says 'the male', which leaves out the טומטום and אנדרוגינוס
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא reads 'הזכר' as meaning a clear male only, which excludes a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.simpleTranslation: As it was taught: 'The male', and not a טומטום or an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers with a ברייתא. The ברייתא points out that the Torah says 'the male' in the ערכין section, and reads that word as excluding anyone whose gender is unclear.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The extra word 'הזכר' (the male) is read as a limit: only someone who is clearly male gets the man's valuation. At this point we only know he does not get the man's amount. Steps 9 and 10 deal with whether he gets the woman's amount.

keyTerms.meaning: A person whose gender cannot be determined
A person with both male and female features

phrases.english: As it was taught: 'The male'
phrases.notes: ויקרא כז:ג, the man's valuation of fifty shekels.

phrases.english: and not a tumtum or a hermaphrodite.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers Step 7 by bringing a ברייתא.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The word 'הזכר' limits the man's valuation to a definite male.

steps.title: Maybe he gets the woman's valuation instead?
steps.stepSummary: The ברייתא suggests that a person excluded from the man's amount might still get the woman's amount.
steps.simpleTranslation: One might think he does not get a man's valuation but does get a woman's valuation.
steps.whatsHappening: Inside the ברייתא, a possible mistake is raised: maybe he is only kept from the man's amount but falls into the woman's amount. This sets up the next line, which rejects this idea.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Leaving someone out of 'male' does not automatically leave him out of 'female'. The ברייתא needs to close this gap to show he has no valuation at all.

keyTerms.meaning: One might have thought (a mistaken idea about to be rejected)
A man's valuation (fifty shekels)
A woman's valuation (thirty shekels)

steps.confusionAlert: Do not stop after Step 8 and think the case is closed. 'Not a male' could still mean 'counted as a female'. The ברייתא has to rule that out separately.

phrases.english: One might think he shall not be in the valuation of a man
but shall be in the valuation of a woman

steps.triggerLanguage: יָכוֹל לֹא יְהֵא בְּעֵרֶךְ אִישׁ אֲבָל יְהֵא בְּעֵרֶךְ אִשָּׁה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Raises a gap in the derivation from Step 8.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Whether someone excluded from the man's valuation receives the woman's valuation.

steps.title: Only a definite male or definite female is valuated
steps.stepSummary: The verses 'הזכר' and 'ואם נקבה היא' together cover only a definite male and a definite female, so a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס get no valuation at all.
steps.simpleTranslation: The verse says 'The male' and 'And if she is a female.' This means a definite male and a definite female, and not a טומטום or an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.whatsHappening: The ברייתא answers the possible mistake by reading both verses together. Each verse covers only a clear case, so an אנדרוגינוס fits under neither.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The man's verse says 'הזכר', and the woman's verse adds 'היא' (she is). This teaches that each valuation needs a clear, certain gender. An אנדרוגינוס therefore has no ערכין valuation at all, which proves the premise used in Step 6.

keyTerms.meaning: The verse teaches (introducing the proof text)
A definite male
A definite female

steps.whatToRemember: An אנדרוגינוס gets neither the man's nor the woman's ערכין valuation. This is why the גמרא says that even according to רבי יהודה, he counts as male only for some laws, such as מילה, and not for all of them.
steps.whyThisMatters: This proves the point from Step 6: the male status רבי יהודה gives the אנדרוגינוס is limited to certain laws, and ערכין is one area where it does not apply.

phrases.english: Therefore the verse states: 'The male,'
and 'And if she is a female.'
A definite male, a definite female
but not a tumtum or a hermaphrodite.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rejects the possible mistake from Step 9 and completes the source requested in Step 7.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: Only a definite male or definite female receives an ערכין valuation. A טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס receive none.
